# Security and privacy

If you find a security or privacy problem in Orma, please **don't open a
public issue**. Email **support@orma.day** with what you found and how to
reproduce it.

Orma keeps your journal in your own cloud storage, as plain Markdown, and runs
no server of its own. Reports we're most interested in include anything that
could expose a vault's contents to someone other than its owner, or send them
anywhere the [privacy policy](https://orma.day/privacy/) doesn't say.
